skills.name: review_back_office
skills.description: Reviewing Backoffice configuration quality, Form.IO mapping, report activation, and admin-field exposure in a backoffice JSON file.

skills.name: component_quality
skills.description: This skill group explains how to review component naming quality in a Form.io JSON file. The reviewer must inspect the input JSON, traverse all relevant top-level and nested components, and evaluate each defined check independently.

skills.name: field_logic_quality
skills.description: This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for unsafe logic execution, missing null/undefined handling, unbounded calculated text output, unsafe required validation on conditionally visible fields, and missing clear-value behavior for approver-edit fields during withdraw or revision flows.

skills.name: form_structure_quality
skills.description: This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for layout structure, top-level wrapper consistency, attachment authorization requirements, logic implementation simplicity, nesting complexity, reusable utility usage, and required platform summary field availability.

skills.name: run_time_quality
skills.description: This skill group explains how to review Form.io JSON files for unsafe calculated display values, JavaScript runtime errors or Form.io console warnings, and forbidden debug logging statements inside executable logic.
